condition.breakout: latest close reaches recent 21-trading-day closing high
condition.earlyWatch: 21-day return >= 60%, relative return >= 40%p, 21-day volume >= 1.2x, 5-day average volume >= 1.5x, MFI >= 75, within -5% from the 21-day high, and above the 10-day average
condition.observation: 21-day return >= 60%, relative return >= 40%p, MFI >= 75, within -5% from the 21-day high, 21-day volume >= 1.2x, 5-day volume >= 1.5x, and above the 10-day average
condition.invalidation: exclude active picks if latest price is <= -8% from signal, below 10-day average, or <= -20% from recent 21-trading-day high
condition.confirmationGuard: confirmed picks require 5-day volume >= 1.8x, setup score >= 75, 21-day return <= 80%, high drawdown within -10%, and no overheat or weak-market downgrade
condition.highConfidence: high-confidence picks require either 21-day volume >= 2.2x and relative return >= 40%p, or drawdown within -3% from the 21-day high
condition.fundamentalValidation: enrich picks with revenue growth, profit growth, and forward PER when available; confirmed picks can be downgraded when support is weak
condition.mirofishAdjustment: adjust setup score and final ordering with a MiroFish-style market/theme fit score; tailwinds raise priority and headwinds can downgrade confirmed picks to observation

note: Forward returns are included only for historical review and are not used in the screen.

mirofish.adjustment: setupScore is adjusted by market/theme fit before final sorting

universe: Nasdaq Trader listed U.S. common stocks and ADRs; ETFs, units, warrants, rights, preferreds, funds, SPAC/acquisition vehicles, and test issues excluded
